scale: 30: one person moved, changed pose, or picked up or put down something.
40: two people moved or changed pose, or one moved and someone took or gave something.
50: several people changed pose or hold new things, or someone came or left.
edit_rule: Edit this picture. Keep the place, the light, every person's face, hair, build and clothes exactly as they are; the camera may move to the shot asked for; change only what the scene now says is different.

shots.look: an intimate medium two-shot of the two people at the heart of the moment
a close-up on one face, filling the frame, to land a feeling
an extreme close-up on eyes, lips or hands, for a charged beat
an over-the-shoulder shot from behind one person toward the other's face
a long telephoto shot from across the room, the pair compressed and isolated in a blur of crowd
a wide shot of the whole room, to show the crowd and where everyone is
a tilted Dutch angle, for tension, unease or drunken chaos
a low angle looking up, so someone looms proud or threatening
a high angle looking down, so someone looks small, lost or overwhelmed
